title: Forward Defence Soft Hands (Chas McIvor)
style: rockabilly two step jangle electric guitar slap back echo walking bass brushed drums hiccup vocal fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections fifties pop swing
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son. The forward defence.
People think it is boring
A good forward defence is the foundation of a CENTURY

[Verse 1]
Good length ball on middle and off stump line
Front foot forward, head over the ball in time
Bat comes down the line of off stump straight
Relaxed top hand at impact, that is how you wait

The top hand controls the bat face angle square
Slightly angled down to the ground right there
No follow through, ball dies at feet
Forward defence, the bowler cannot beat

[Pre-Chorus]
Head over ball, front foot toward
Top hand relaxed, no follow forward
Angled bat, ball drops down
Forward defence, hold your ground

[Chorus]
Forward defence, head over ball
Front foot toward pitch, no follow at all
Angled bat, ball drops at feet
Forward defence, the bowler cannot beat

[Verse 2]
Relaxed hands mean the ball dies in the grass
No edge to the slips, no catch, let it pass
Top hand controls all, bottom stays loose
Forward defence with rigid hands, that is no use

[Bridge]
Bluey: And he is defending solidly here, impeccable technique on display
Trevor: The relaxed top hand is doing the work, no edge chance whatsoever
Chas: Son, I literally stood him in the yard and said soft hands for three hundred repetitions

[Chorus]
Forward defence, head over ball
Front foot toward pitch, no follow at all
Angled bat, ball drops at feet
Forward defence, the bowler cannot beat

[Outro]
Soft hands son
Soft hands
Thats my boy
